8df7252c9343a843.g: If you are authorized to approach, you will have to follow the left road to approach the transit area. Once you approach the transit area, your weapon will be automatically lowered. You won't be able to transit without having Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence in your task inventory if you are doing the Savior ending. A few actions can get you killed by the port garrison: * Going further than the first anti-tank barrier without presenting an access item. * Going outside of the road around the transit area. * Pulling out a weapon, or getting a weapon back in your hands after it has been lowered.

d40f148e403d1e85.g: Once the Pier door has been opened, all players in the raid will have 3 minutes to reach the Zubr Boat extraction at the end of the pier before the extraction becomes unavailable regardless of the current raid time left. You will have to fight a final team of Black Division soldiers on the pier, before reaching the boat. The extraction timer coincides with the three minute timer, once the timer is up, any players in the extraction zone will escape and a cinematic related to the ending you chose will start. Successfully completing the raid will allow you to obtain one of the game's endings. Upon dying or extracting, the state of your character is returned to what it was before entering Terminal, besides the consumed access item.

7fc4ac7ce859af00.g: To access the loading zone, you will have to get through the admin building. You will have to fight Scavs on the path to it and a team of Black Division soldiers waiting at the entrance of the building. Once all Black Division soldiers have been neutralized, you have to enter the building and swipe the Black Division keycard at the scanner next to the door. There are several resupply resources (Provisions, medical items) scattered about in the hallway immediately inside the door. Scavs spawning ahead will attempt to enter the hallway from the far end while you are inside.

You can do this by either using a nearby found SZ-1 explosive charge to open the door, by pushing it open with Elite level Strength, or by pushing it open together with another player. You will have to fight a squad of Black Division soldiers around the various SZ-1 explosive charge spawns. It is recommend to clear them first before looking for the charge.

5e2aaf5425e11724.g: Electrical panels can be repaired with bare hands, but the chance to succeed is low. If you fail a repair, the panel will inflict damage to your arms. You will need to find and repair one to five electrical panels scattered around Terminal in order to restore power to the pumping station. The amount of panels that are required to be repaired depends on the number of players in the raid: * Solo players will always have a single panel to repair (Either panel number 9 or 10). * With 2-5 players, at least 1, but up to 5 panels will need to be repaired across all panel locations. Two Toolsets can be found on Terminal in static locations, both are guaranteed to spawn every raid.

5d5e60ead399ba79.g: You now need to access the pier to reach the Zubr Boat extraction. You can reach the door to the pier in a few ways: * You can go through the container loading bay in the east, this avoids fighting the Scav Boss that can spawn, but requires backtracking, and is a longer path. (Green path) * You can go through the container loading bay in the center, but you might have to fight the Scav Boss that can spawn, in addition to the team of Black Division soldiers nearby. (Blue path) * You can go through the container loading bay in the west, sticking close to the water, this may avoid fighting the Scav Boss that can spawn, but can end up in a long distance battle with a squad of Black Division soldiers at the end of the loading bay. (Purple path) On all possible paths, you will have to fight squads of Black Division soldiers before reaching the pier door.
